synthetic_test.assertions: Each applicable scenario asserts physical-attempt and dollar ceilings, rolling 60-second token reservations, unchanged original ledger hashes, zero production promotion, no human-gold claim and closed response handles.

repairs: Pin and verify frozen validator/runtime SHA before model calls.
Preserve immutable per-attempt private HTTP responses before interpretation, including errors, filters and malformed responses; close response handles.
Catch identity-token acquisition/contract failures into a precise no-model-call status rather than leaving running as the final state.
Add provider message.refusal to the local protected set without retry or rerouting.

Skip already protected records with quarantined_no_call on restart instead of aborting all remaining records after the local exclusion file grows. Existing result files and historical ledgers remain unchanged.
resource_and_correctness_limits: This is bounded synthetic/structural QA, not a claim that the real deployment has run or that outputs are accurate.
HTTP status retry allowlist and frozen request/token/cost/attempt bounds are unchanged.
Arbitrary malicious local filesystem tampering and every possible provider failure are not exhaustively tested.
Run receipts may finish with candidate-only engineering checks; promotion and semantic accuracy are not inferred.
